Recorded claim:
The menus event contract introduced selectedFolders for future multi-folder UI selection. The folder pane initially wrapped its one active folder in an array. The event provides converted folders only when accountsRead is granted. Current code still maps selectedFolders as an array. Code handling this event should not assume an object or require that the UI already supports multi-selection.
